addOnPresets.name: Welcome Drink
addOnPresets.details: One 250 ml glass of chilled, non-alcoholic house calamansi juice per registered guest, served on arrival.

addOnPresets.name: Breakfast
addOnPresets.details: One plated Filipino breakfast for one guest with garlic rice, egg, seasonal fruit, and coffee or tea. Includes one breakfast during the stay.

addOnPresets.name: Beach Picnic Lunch
addOnPresets.details: One packed chicken sandwich lunch for one guest with seasonal fruit, chips, and bottled water. Prepared for pickup at the resort.

addOnPresets.name: Barbecue Set
addOnPresets.details: One grilled chicken barbecue set for two guests with steamed rice, seasonal vegetables, sauces, and grill setup.

addOnPresets.name: Kayak Rental
addOnPresets.details: One single kayak for one hour, including paddle, life jacket, and a brief safety orientation.

addOnPresets.name: Paddleboard Rental
addOnPresets.details: One paddleboard for one hour, including paddle, ankle leash, life jacket, and a brief safety orientation.

addOnPresets.name: Snorkeling Gear Rental
addOnPresets.details: One sanitized mask, snorkel, and fins set for one guest for one day. Equipment is issued in available sizes.

addOnPresets.name: Beach Umbrella Rental
addOnPresets.details: One beach umbrella with two beach chairs for one day, including setup and takedown in the resort's beach area.

addOnPresets.name: Island-Hopping Trip
addOnPresets.details: One guest on a shared half-day island-hopping trip with boat, local guide, life jacket, and drinking water. Meals and entrance fees are excluded.

addOnPresets.name: Guided Snorkeling Tour
addOnPresets.details: One 90-minute guided snorkeling session for one guest, including mask, snorkel, fins, and life jacket. Transfers are not included.

addOnPresets.name: Airport Transfer
addOnPresets.details: One-way private sedan transfer between the nearest airport and resort for up to three passengers with standard luggage.

addOnPresets.name: Boat Transfer
addOnPresets.details: One passenger on a one-way shared boat transfer between the resort and its designated port, including standard baggage and a life jacket.

addOnPresets.name: Massage
addOnPresets.details: One 60-minute relaxation massage for one guest, provided in the resort spa by an available therapist.

addOnPresets.name: Extra Bed
addOnPresets.details: One rollaway bed with fresh linens set up in the room for one night.

addOnPresets.name: Beach Celebration Package
addOnPresets.details: Two-hour private beach setup for up to 10 guests with basic decorations, table and chairs, and post-event cleanup. Food is not included.

addOnPresets.name: Other Resort Offering
addOnPresets.details: One standard resort service for one guest, provided once during the stay. Includes only the service described by its name.
